title: Chapter 208: Intelligence Transaction And Space Transmission
content:
Chapter 208: Intelligence Transaction And Space Transmission

In Mengzhong City, Wu Qing saw through the host that the branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has begun to take shape.

With the application of a large number of goblin engineering machinery, sufficient personnel and material support, and the continuous work day and night, this branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, which is as large as a small city, will be built soon.

Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce took the initiative to find the Zerg and said that he wanted to meet Wu Qing to discuss something.

Wu Qing thought about it and did not let Gong Zhe come to him. He asked the Zerg clone who returned from the battlefield to go to Mengzhong City.

At this time, the Zerg clone had arrived in Mengzhong City and met with Gong Zhe.

"Lord, the tribe has received news that the actual application of the Zerg energy coin is very good!"

"I have received an order here to fully support the development of the Zerg. If you need anything in the future, please don't hesitate to ask the Lord!"

Gong Zhe brought Wu Qing a good news.

Wu Qing smiled and took the initiative to say: "Just this morning, we just annihilated the army of the bear goblin tribe led by more than 300,000 troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department, and are now sweeping the territory of the bear goblin tribe."

"We will soon be able to completely eliminate all the forces of the bear goblin tribe in this area."

Gong Zhe was very surprised when he heard this: "The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department? The bear goblin tribe actually sent this army here?"

"It's really surprising!"

"The lord can destroy this army. It seems that the Zerg has another strong army coming!"

Gong Zhe did not doubt what Wu Qing said, because Wu Qing had no need to lie to him.

The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department is not something that everyone knows.

In addition to receiving awards and encouragement from the tribe, Gong Zhe also received a lot of intelligence, all of which is related to the Zerg.

This intelligence is very valuable, and Gong Zhe needs to operate it well to deepen the relationship with the Zerg.

Wu Qing knew that everything the goblins did was for Zerg energy coins. If he wanted to gain something from Gong Zhe, a shrewd businessman, he had to be willing to pay.

Wu Qing smiled and said, "The Zerg has been very supportive recently, and we have performed well on the battlefield. We just got a batch of Zerg energy coins, and I will have someone send them to you later."

Gong Zhe was very happy to learn that there was another batch of Zerg energy coins.

"Thank you very much!"

"Lord, I came to see you this time because I just got some information from the tribe and wanted to talk to you about the situation!"

After getting what he wanted, Gong Zhe began to give Wu Qing benefits.

"Where we are now is an inconspicuous valley at the foot of the Endless Mountains. It is blocked by the Endless Mountains on three sides, and only the north is connected to the outside world!"

"It is rumored that there is an opportunity in this place. The two major tribes, the Tengu and Naga, seem to have some more accurate intelligence, so they sent people from their tribes to build a territory here to look for opportunities!"

"The Endless Mountains is a forbidden place. It is surrounded by the Endless Mountains on three sides. There are some taboos that we don't know about. The two tribes dare not send the army here rashly because of its too strong strength!"

"This situation lasted for a long time until the influence of the war between the outside camps, this place slowly entered the front line area of the camp battle, and the evil god camp sent two tribes to forcefully enter the boundary, and finally formed the current situation!"

Gong Zhe first gave Wu Qing a brief introduction to the geography and history of this area.

If the Goblin Chamber of Commerce had not collected this information and told Wu Qing, it would be very difficult for Wu Qing to figure it out by himself.

With this information, Wu Qing has a macro understanding of this area.

"What are the taboos here?"

This is a question that Wu Qing is very concerned about.

"I don't know the details, but it should be related to the mysterious and strange lord. These are taboo topics, and few people will talk about them!"

"The tribe just warned that powerful tribesmen should not stay in this area, and elite troops should not be sent here to perform tasks!"

"The last time the elder came here in person, he took a big risk!"

Gong Zhe explained.

Wu Qing then understood that the powerful goblin elder was in a hurry to leave. He was busy on the one hand, but more importantly, he was afraid.

This shows that this area is indeed very dangerous for those strong people.

But Wu Qing and the Queen of the Insects did not feel threatened. I don't know if the system did something behind the scenes.

This situation is actually very good for Wu Qing. Too powerful forces dare not come in easily. This is a good base.

Wu Qing believes in the system. Since the system threw him here, it means that the danger here is controllable, so now he doesn't have to spend his mind thinking about this problem. When he is strong enough, everything will come to light.

The Zerg just needs to develop according to the plan, and there is no need to take too much into consideration like other races.

"The elders asked the Lord to lead the Zerg to fight out of here as soon as possible, that's why!"

"Now the bear goblins have lost a direct army of the Spirit God Green Tribe here, they are likely to abandon this place, this place has no other value except for the illusory rumors!"

"I heard that the Lord has sent troops to support the Naga tribe. With the current strength of the Zerg, it is only a matter of time for them to unite with the Naga tribe and defeat the demon tribe!"

"As long as the Lord defeats the two evil god camps in this area and has enough Zerg energy coins, I can apply to the tribe to build a space transmission channel here!"

"At that time, the Zerg army can be directly teleported to the main battlefield of the camp battle to make achievements!"

Gong Zhe mentioned something that Wu Qing was very concerned about.

"President Gong Zhe, can you introduce the space transmission channel?"

Wu Qing knew that asking this question was somewhat inconsistent with the identity of the Zerg clan. Facing Gong Zhe's somewhat strange look, he added: "The Zerg's space transmission uses the Zerg's special transmission buildings, which should be different from your space transmission channel."

Because this world is extremely vast, the transmission of personnel, materials and information over long distances must rely on space transmission channels. If people just walk, some people will never reach a slightly farther place in their lifetime.

This is also the reason why everyone is concerned about the Zerg's continuous increase in troops, but does not pay attention to the specific location of the Zerg clan. With the existence of space transmission channels, it is not surprising to know where the Zerg's nest is.

"It turns out that the Zerg's space transmission is also a self-contained system, which is really admirable!"

"The space transmission channel is a space transmission device that the local camp has continuously improved after countless years of research and accumulation. It is large and small, in different forms, consumes energy, and can transmit personnel and materials to distant places!"

"The construction of the space transmission channel requires a lot of precious resources and a lot of luck!"

"Therefore, each space transmission channel is very important and will not be built easily!"

"The evil god camp also has a transmission channel with similar functions!"

Gong Zhe introduced to Wu Qing.

"I see."

"President Gong Zhe, if we want to completely control this area, do you have any good suggestions?"

Wu Qing not only wants the territory of the bear goblins and the demons, but also the territory of the Tengu and Naga. He wants to completely control this area and turn it into a base for the Zerg.

For the two races in the same camp, the Tengu is easier to deal with, but the Naga will be more difficult.

The intelligence capabilities of the goblins are not comparable to those of the current Zerg. With the intelligence in Gong Zhe's hands, he may be able to give Wu Qing some useful suggestions.

Gong Zhe was not surprised by Wu Qing's idea. A powerful clan that has just entered the world must need a large enough territory to develop.

He thought for a while and said, "Lord, I don't have any insights. I can only tell you what I know for your reference!"

"With the strength of the army in your hands, it should not be a problem to control the territory of the enemy camp. Now it is mainly a problem of the two allied races!"

"As far as I know, the Tengu tribe has planned to leave after so many years of suffering. Now there are some problems within the Tengu tribe. They no longer have the energy to continue to pay attention to the rumored opportunities here!"

"From their recent battles with the bear goblins, it can be seen that they originally Just ready to withdraw! "

"As long as we put some pressure on them, they will withdraw, it is very likely!"

"As for the Naga tribe, their young elder is not simple. Some time ago, he has been fighting against the two tribes of the evil god camp alone and persisted!"

"The Naga tribe is very upright. It is useless to force them to withdraw. It will only arouse their resistance!"

"But the Naga tribe values friendship more. This requires the lords to think of some ways and make some exchanges!"

Gong Zhe told Wu Qing some information very carefully.

This information is very important to Wu Qing. Knowing some of the situations of the Tengu and Naga tribes, the Zerg's confidence in taking over this area has increased a little bit.

"Thank you very much for the advice of President Gong Zhe!"

Next, Wu Qing continued to ask Gong Zhe some questions, and Gong Zhe tried his best to give appropriate replies.

This is an unspoken intelligence transaction. Wu Qing got the information he wanted and would pay enough Zerg energy coins as a reward.

While Gong Zhe was selling intelligence, he was also supporting the Zerg to develop better so that he could get more Zerg Energy Coins from the Zerg.

This is a win-win deal.

Wu Qing obtained a lot of key intelligence from Gong Zhe, especially some intelligence about the main battlefield of the confrontation between the camps in this world, which is very important for the Zerg to go out in the future.

According to Gong Zhe, the main battlefield does not refer to a place, but to the battlefield area where both sides have invested a certain amount of strength.

Some large main battlefields are really the battles of all races, with countless troops and powerful arms.

Any army fighting in that main battlefield can sweep the four major races in this area.

So, the outside world is very cruel, and the Zerg needs to continue to work hard.
